subject: PO activation constraints, invoice cadence and volume slab alignment
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@medsol.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@medsol.com
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO fields & billing cadence for Redwood engagement

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team was impressed with the latency profiling and cost mitigation suggestions. Procurement asked me to follow up on a few items before we can issue a PO:

- PO needs the vendor legal name, remit address, and Redwood tax ID on line 1
- They require a single-line PO number on the invoice header (no split PO support in our ERP)
- Net terms are currently net45 for our vendor policy (we can escalate to net30 with a supplier scorecard exception)
- We prefer monthly consolidated invoices but are prepared to accept weekly statements if the vendor supports a weekly-accumulation invoice header
- Pricing question: procurement expects volume slabs for token consumption to be tied to PO milestones (quarterly true-ups). Can your billing team map usage bands to PO references?

I've attached our standard PO template for your finance and legal teams. Can you confirm if Redwood can: 1) accept net45 on this deal, 2) consolidate invoices monthly while referencing the single PO, and 3) produce a monthly usage slab report tied to the PO number?

If any of the constraints are blockers, let me know what exceptions you can offer (e.g., early invoice windows, partial prepay). We want to keep the timeline but need procurement sign-off by 8/20.

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Senior Procurement Manager
MedSol Therapeutics

Attachment: MedSol_PO_Template.pdf (application/pdf)
From: aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@medsol.com>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com, markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO fields & billing cadence for Redwood engagement

Hi Lena — really appreciate the clear list. Short answers up front: we can work with the PO single-line requirement, and we can reference a single PO number on all invoices. On net terms we typically default to net30 for new Enterprise contracts but we can accommodate net45 with a small fee/credit tradeoff (details below). Monthly consolidated invoices are fine; weekly statements are also supported if your AP needs them.

Details:
- Vendor legal name and tax info: Redwood Inference, Inc. / 123 Redwood Way, San Francisco, CA / Tax ID: 94-XXXXXXX — I’ll include a PDF invoice sample showing the single-line PO header.
- PO mapping to usage slabs: our billing system can attach a PO reference to each invoice and produce a monthly usage slab report (CSV) grouped by token bands. We will need the exact slab thresholds to set thresholds correctly — are you proposing quarterly true-ups at X, Y, Z monthly averaged consumption levels?
- Net45: we can accept net45 if MedSol agrees to either a 1.0% monthly processing fee on outstanding balances or a $10k prepayment credit against the first invoice. If you’d like, we can model both scenarios.

Next steps: I’ll loop in Vanessa (Finance) and Markus (Legal) to confirm the technical invoice layout and finalize the acceptance language. Can you provide a filled example PO (even draft) so we can test the mapping?

— Aditya Rao
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_Invoice_Sample.pdf (application/pdf)
From: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
To: aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@medsol.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO fields & billing cadence for Redwood engagement

Hi Lena / Aditya,

Thanks — quick finance notes:
- We will populate vendor tax info and legal address on the invoice PDF as requested.
- Single-line PO: we can display the PO number in the invoice header and add an ERP-friendly PO reference field in the PDF metadata so your systems can pick it up.
- Consolidated monthly invoice: easiest for reconciliation. If MedSol requests weekly statements, we can produce a weekly aging CSV and a single monthly invoice that sums the weeks.
- Net45 option: Vanessa confirms we can accept net45 under either of the two options Aditya proposed. From a cashflow perspective, the 1.0% processing fee is our standard for extended terms on non-prepaid contracts.

I started a DocuSign-ready invoice template and a sample CSV export that shows how slab-band rows will look. I’ll attach both to the final contract packet once we have a draft PO.

Vanessa Ortiz
VP, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
From: markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
To: aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@medsol.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO fields & billing cadence for Redwood engagement

Lena / team — legal thumbprint: please ensure the PO includes Redwood’s master agreement reference (Redwood MSA v3.1) and a clause that the PO is "subject to" the MSA to avoid mismatched T&Cs. Also confirm whether MedSol requires any PO-specific indemnity or data residency language — those are not typically expressed in a PO but in the main SOW/MSA.

On the slab mapping: we’re fine to provide a machine-readable CSV that maps invoice lines to slab IDs and the PO number. Recommend adding a single line in the SOW that the quarterly true-up calculation will be performed within 15 days of quarter close and any overage/credit will be invoiced/credited on the next monthly invoice.

If procurement needs a PO field beyond the single-line (e.g., sub-ledger or cost-center), we can accept a secondary reference in the PDF metadata, but we won’t print it on the visible header.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Director, Legal Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@medsol.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@medsol.com
Date: Fri, 13 Aug 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO fields & billing cadence for Redwood engagement

Aditya / Vanessa / Markus — attached is the draft PO (signed by our sourcing team) with the single-line PO number and cost-center reference in the metadata. We kept the net45 term but added the quarterly true-up sentence to the SOW as requested. Please review and confirm acceptance.

We’d prefer the $10k prepayment credit vs the 1.0% fee — that helps us hit internal ROI numbers. If Redwood accepts the $10k prepay, procurement will issue the PO and routing to AP can begin.

Attachment: signed_PO_MS-TX-2027-09.pdf (application/pdf)

On acceptance, can you 1) confirm the invoice will list the single PO in the header and include the PO number in the PDF metadata, 2) confirm monthly consolidated invoice with slab CSV attached, and 3) provide a sample quarterly true-up calculation table? We need to present this to the finance committee next Tuesday.

Regards,
Lena Ortiz
Senior Procurement Manager
MedSol Therapeutics
